title: RPG maker MV - How to add intermediate picture beetween each map

posts.author: Animation_Fig
posts.body:
Hello,
I would like to add an intermediate picture between some of my maps to inform the player that they are starting a new map in RPG maker MV.
I have seen that it is possible to lauch this effect when you interact with other characters but is it possible whan changing maps ?
a bit like that but with an illustration of the map that will be discovered by the player after.
It would be like a loading screen (without the launch bar wich would not be useful).
Thank you
.
Baptiste

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Note, from the description of this forum section:
That said, you'd just use the Show Picture event command.
Instead of making your event just transfer the player, have it Show Picture, Wait for a few seconds' worth of frames, and
then
erase the picture and transfer the player.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
however if that picture is based on the next map, it might be better to place that show picture into a parallel process at the beginning of the next map, followed by either a wait or a button press before erasing picture and event.
that is especially better if you have non-linear maps: in the solution above different transfers to different maps would need different pictures for such a case instead of simply having one event on each map for the mapo-specific picture
